skills.name: Convert mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert between mixed numbers and improper fractions, including handling improper fractions within mixed numbers.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Identify and apply a common denominator for fractions with different denominators.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions with a common denominator and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Borrow or regroup
skills.definition: Borrow one from the whole number part and convert it to a fraction with the common denominator to allow subtraction when the fraction part of the minuend is smaller.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce fractions to lowest terms and convert improper fractions to mixed numbers.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of mixed numbers, including cases where the subtrahend has no fraction.
